description: Local: Tricot Cabinet Color price filter, side panel and full mode, each through its own Price control (PF-01..04). Read-only, guarded.

args.function: async () => { const txt=s=>(s||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); const root=document; if(!root) return 'NO ROOT'; const btn=[...root.querySelectorAll('button[aria-haspopup=listbox]')].filter(b=>{const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();return r.width>0 && (r.left>=innerWidth*0.62);}).find(b=>/^(Price|Standard \$|Classic \$\$|Specialty \$\$\$|Exclusive \$\$\$\$|Show all)$/.test(txt(b.innerText))); if(!btn) return 'NO PRICE BUTTON'; const was=txt(btn.innerText); btn.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const lb=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=listbox][aria-label=Price]')].pop(); if(!lb) return 'NO LISTBOX'; const opts=[...lb.querySelectorAll('[role=option]')]; const names=opts.map(o=>txt(o.querySelector('span')?.innerText||o.innerText)); const o=opts.find(o=>txt(o.querySelector('span')?.innerText||o.innerText)==="Standard $"); if(!o) return {err:'NO OPTION', names}; (o.querySelector('button')||o).click(); return {was, picked:"Standard $", offered:names}; }

async () => { const txt=s=>(s||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); const root=document; if(!root) return 'NO ROOT'; const btn=[...root.querySelectorAll('button[aria-haspopup=listbox]')].filter(b=>{const r=b.getBoundingClientRect();return r.width>0 && (r.left>=innerWidth*0.62);}).find(b=>/^(Price|Standard \$|Classic \$\$|Specialty \$\$\$|Exclusive \$\$\$\$|Show all)$/.test(txt(b.innerText))); if(!btn) return 'NO PRICE BUTTON'; const was=txt(btn.innerText); btn.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const lb=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=listbox][aria-label=Price]')].pop(); if(!lb) return 'NO LISTBOX'; const opts=[...lb.querySelectorAll('[role=option]')]; const names=opts.map(o=>txt(o.querySelector('span')?.innerText||o.innerText)); const o=opts.find(o=>txt(o.querySelector('span')?.innerText||o.innerText)==="Classic $$"); if(!o) return {err:'NO OPTION', names}; (o.querySelector('button')||o).click(); return {was, picked:"Classic $$", offered:names}; }

() => { const txt=s=>(s||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); const d=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); if(!d) return {dialog:false}; const vis=e=>{const r=e.getBoundingClientRect();return r.width>0&&r.height>0}; const names=[...d.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>e.children.length===0&&vis(e)).map(e=>txt(e.innerText)).filter(t=>/^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z ]* \d{3}( MT)?$/.test(t)); const groups=[...d.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>e.children.length===0&&vis(e)).map(e=>txt(e.innerText)).filter(t=>/^(Lacquered MT|Wood Veneer)$/.test(t)); return {dialog:true, count:new Set(names).size, swatches:[...new Set(names)].sort(), groups:[...new Set(groups)]}; }
